content.text:
**Recommend resolving SEM-001 by preserving the existing arithmetic and correcting the manual:** round the mean with `floor(mean + 0.5)`, then use Average = rounded mean, Higher/Longer = rounded mean + range, and Lower/Shorter = twice the minimum − rounded mean. This is a compatibility decision, not completed fractional or Lower behavior acceptance.

The evidence supports established behavior: [functions.lua:439](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/helpers/functions.lua:439) explicitly returns `floor((sum / count) + 0.5)`; [pattern.lua:156](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/pattern.lua:156) implements all three formulas and bypasses arithmetic for one contributor. Git blame traces the formulas to `83274543` (March 2024) and the current rounding expression to `35f164a4` (September 2024). The conflicting prose is at [README.md:640](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/README.md:640), [653](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/README.md:653), and [664](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/README.md:664).

**Symmetry does not justify a replacement:** Higher and Lower are not symmetric about the mean. For `[2,2,8]`, their outputs are `10` and `0`; a symmetric alternative would produce `−2` for Lower. Conversely, interpreting Lower as mean−minimum would turn equal positive inputs `[6,6]` into zero. Preserving longstanding musical output is the least-surprise choice under the standing instruction; history supports continuity, although it does not prove original author intent. This rationale is independent of the Digitakt NRPN exception.

Exact proposed manual clarification:

> For numeric note, velocity and length merges, one contributing value passes through unchanged by the merge calculation. With two or more contributors, first calculate their arithmetic mean and round it to the nearest integer, choosing the greater integer at an exact half: 1.5 becomes 2, −1.5 becomes −1, and −0.5 becomes 0. Call this rounded mean A, the smallest contributing value m, and the largest M.
>
> **Average:** A.  
> **Higher / Longer:** A + (M − m).  
> **Lower / Shorter:** m − (A − m), equivalently 2m − A.
>
> Only the mean is rounded at this stage; fractional inputs can still produce fractional Higher/Longer or Lower/Shorter results. These names do not guarantee a result above or below every input after rounding. Length calculations use source lengths after interruption by another trig in that pattern. Note results subsequently undergo the configured scale and pentatonic processing.

The length qualification follows [pattern.lua:30](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/pattern.lua:30).

**Independent arithmetic contract:** freeze these hand-derived expectations before implementing tests; expected values must not call Mosaic’s averaging, merging, or quantiser helpers.

| Contributors | Exact mean | Average | Higher/Longer | Lower/Shorter |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `[6,6]` | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| `[2,2,8]` | 4 | 4 | 10 | 0 |
| `[1,2]` | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 0 |
| `[−2,−1]` | −1.5 | −1 | 0 | −3 |
| `[−1,0]` | −0.5 | 0 | 1 | −2 |
| `[1.25,2.25]` | 1.75 | 2 | 3 | 0.5 |
| `[0.25,0.25]` | 0.25 | 0 | 0 | 0.5 |
| `[0.25]` | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 |

Highest-value additional oracles are exact means immediately below/at/above positive and negative half boundaries, three-contributor noninteger means, contributor-order invariance, and independent application to all three fields. Native acceptance should then exercise real controls and independently tabulated MIDI pitches, velocities and release timing in both clock modes.

**Keep downstream validity separate:** MIDI bounds/clamps, zero or negative lengths, fractional release timing, and scale/pentatonic mapping require their own behavior tests. Arithmetic outputs alone cannot settle them; [quantiser.lua:425](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/lib/quantiser.lua:425) already demonstrates separate playable-pitch handling. The [inventory:2886](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/manual-inventory.json:2886) still records Lower as unimplemented. This decision does not complete manual reconciliation or release acceptance.

**CONFIDENCE: High** in this recommendation; documented contrary musical intent could change it, and fractional/Lower native behavior was not verified here—no tests ran or files changed.
